question_this_run_was_sent_to_answer: The foundation-model side of EXP-005's Freddie Mac falsifying run on build 2004H2-E, paired with the classical side already recorded (commits dc50bdc, 3aad385, 001b24b): the scorecard, the full GBM and GBM-50k on three context seeds and all 38 half-year cohorts passed the AUC-on-2005H1 halt, so this bundle's foundation-model cells were scored on its first three cohorts, on the primary matrix (upb_to_limit, the ratio of the balance to the year's conforming limit), on context seed 20260911 only; the grid scores every cohort of the build on all three seeds.

what_it_measured.model: tabpfn@t1, library tabpfn 8.5.0; checkpoint(s) present on the node: tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212.ckpt (sha256 bdc7dbd5...), tabpfn-v3-classifier-v3_default.ckpt (sha256 d0d865d5...)
what_it_measured.context: 50,000 rows, context seed 20260911; softmax_temperature 1.0, categorical_features_indices [3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10] (bundle-specific to this ablation, ok=True), ignore_pretraining_limits true, n_estimators auto, random_state 0, balance_probabilities false
what_it_measured.chunk: 20,000 scored rows per forward call (--chunk 20000); the 50,000-row reference cell ran in three calls; the three cohort cells (24,233 / 24,082 / 23,280 rows) ran in two calls each; rows are scored independently and the chunking changes no probability
what_it_measured.repeat: 2005H1 scored twice from a fresh fit: largest absolute disagreement 0.0, no row differs; the second pass is the repeat check and its own seconds are not recorded separately in node.json, only the probability agreement.

timing_caveat: This is a measurement, not a caveated reading: the rented instance was idle and dedicated to this run (four LC probe jobs, then twelve Freddie Mac jobs, back to back, no other process). Per-cell seconds and wall_seconds in node.json stand as recorded; the cohort cells here run at a lower rows/second rate than the LC probe's own cohort cells (bigger cohorts, more forward-call chunks per cell, not a different device).
tuning_budget: Zero trials, no validation split, every parameter at the library default except those the command names. The classical models this pairs with were tuned on their own pool (build.json of the build's score run); the asymmetry runs both ways, since the 50,000-row control inherits the point chosen on the full pool.
